north_star: See what your agents can reach, and what changed since you last said OK.
positioning: Package-lock for agent authority (Authority Watch). Host-first; PR gate is the team upsell.

assessment_model.capability: What a component can potentially reach
assessment_model.exposure: How reachable that capability is and under which identity
assessment_model.security_finding: Evidenced violation of a defined security property
assessment_model.authority_layers: DECLARED | CONFIGURED | EFFECTIVE | VERIFIED (passive scan = DECLARED/CONFIGURED only)
assessment_model.declared_vs_effective: Host profiles declare configuration; effective permissions stay NOT VERIFIED without host/runtime evidence
assessment_model.verdict: PASS | NEEDS_REVIEW | BASELINE_ADOPTED | FAIL_CLOSED (authority change control)
assessment_model.label: GROWTH | REDUCTION | NONE (what the lock delta is, not a verdict)
assessment_model.internal_scan_decision: BLOCK | REVIEW | NO-GATED-FINDINGS (annotation layer; never a second public gate)
